call Troy and Chad. They went to the
same state school, graduated in 2010
with the same engineering degree, got
jobs at competing firms in the same city
making within $5,000 of each other. Both
are now 37 years old, both married, both
have kids. From the outside, their lives
look identical. Except, Troy drives a
2024 Ford F-150 Lariat with a $1,000
monthly payment. Chad drives a 2020
Toyota Camry he bought used 3 years ago,
paid off last spring. Troy has $14,
